*MACIEJ DOŁ ˛ EGA AND PIOTR ŚNIADY*

43 pp, 25 sections.

**Abstract.** We introduce a large class of random Y oung diagrams which can be regarded as a natural one-parameter deformation of so me classi- cal Y oung diagram ensembles; a deformation which is related to Jack polynomials and Jack characters. We also say that λ is a partition of |λ| := λ1 + · · · + λl.
